bioconda.name: pairassembler
bioconda.summary: Fast and resource-frugal paired-end sequencing read merger.
bioconda.description:
pairassembler is a fast and resource-frugal paired-end sequencing read merger, which
installs under the abbreviated executable name "pairasm". pairassembler offers
SIMD-accelerated pair overlap discovery, optional overlap validation, pair consensus
calling, and pair error correction.
